3-AR
Stimulation of lipolysis. Induction of thermogenesis. Reduction of leptin mRNA levels
Nuclear receptors
Androgen
Control of adipose tissue development (antiadipogenic signals). Modulation of leptin
expression
Estrogen
Control of adipose tissue development (proadipogenic signals). Modulation of leptin
expression
Glucocorticoids
Stimulation of adipocyte differentiation
PPARd
Regulation of fat metabolism. Plays a central role in fatty acid-controlled differentiation of
preadipose cells
PPARg
Induction of adipocyte differentiation and insulin sensitivity
RAR/RXR
Regulation of adipocyte differentiation
T3
Stimulation of lipolysis. Regulation of leptin secretion. Induction of adipocyte
differentiation. Regulation of insulin effects
Lipoprotein receptors
HDL
Clearance and metabolism of HDL
LDL
Stimulation of cholesterol uptake
VLDL
Binding and internalization of VLDL particles. Involvement in lipid accumulation
